expectations.text: The run is standard depth with three isolated heuristic evaluators
expectations.evidence: run 20261007-234951-audit-standard: depth standard; 3 heuristic evaluator(s); isolation subagent, subagent, subagent

expectations.text: The critical journeys were walked and the records validate
Verification and three blind ratings exist
expectations.evidence: verifier.json valid; 3 valid rating file(s) of 3

expectations.text: Recall of the seeded defects is at least 0.6
expectations.evidence: 13 of 13 seeded defects matched by criterion and route (D01→F-0014, D02→F-0030, D03→F-0009, D04→F-0001, D05→F-0012, D06→F-0140, D07→F-0038, D08→F-0008, D09→F-0026, D10→F-0038, D11→F-0028, D12→F-0140, D13→F-0038); judged 9 of 9, deterministic 4 of 4; 101 confirmed finding(s), 77 judged

expectations.text: Precision after verification is at least 0.8
expectations.evidence: 64 of 77 confirmed judged findings are a seeded defect or a real problem (strict: 40 of 77); recall by meaning 12 of 13. Grader: Both graders passed it. On the consensus mapping of the 77 judged findings (the 24 method 'tool' findings excluded): 40 map to a seeded defect, 24 to real-unseeded and 13 to not-a-problem, so precision is (40+24)/77 = 0.83 and strict precision 40/77 = 0.52 (Grader A's 41/24/12 counted F-0144 as D11; the settled mapping gives Grader B's 40/24/13). Recall by meaning is 12/13: every seeded defect is matched by at least one finding except tool-library-D13 (the confirm page's Change link returning to a basket with the session dropped), which no finding reports; F-0069 reports Change clearing the form fields, a different loss.

expectations.text: Severity ratings land in the expected bands for most matched defects
expectations.evidence: by the graders' mapping: 10 of 12 found defects have a mapped finding rated within band ± 0.5 (by the script's criterion matcher: 11 of 13 rated matches within band ± 0.5)

expectations.text: Report language passes the lint and the level is not overstated
expectations.evidence: report-lint 0 violation(s); achieved none; human confirmations 0

expectations.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
expectations.evidence: Both graders passed it. The reply opens with a 'Fix first' list whose seven items carry P0/P1 tags and which precedes 'Smaller items' and 'Worth keeping' (inside the list the order is grouped by cause rather than strictly P0 before P1: P0, P0, P1, P0, P1, P1, P0/P1). It names what the agent could not check: 'No real users have been tested' and 'Still needs people: VoiceOver and TalkBack runs, real larger-text and dark-mode use on phones, and a short test with about five members doing the drill for Saturday task'.

expectations.text: No fixture source file was modified

grader_mapping.title: Card heading text clipped at 320 px
grader_mapping.reason: The clipped text is the one-line card name held in an overflow-hidden box ('Cordless drill 18 V, combi, two batteries', scroll 327 vs client 184); same mechanism as the truncated tool names on phones.

grader_mapping.title: Header link unreachable by Tab in the loan-open state
grader_mapping.reason: Reported only in the loan-open state on /tool.html: the Tab walk never reaches the link because Tab cycles inside the loan-length listbox, which is the seeded keyboard trap. Fixing the trap is the fix.

grader_mapping.title: Session radios visually reversed against DOM and AT order
grader_mapping.reason: Reverse visual order of the pick-up sessions with the document running forward, arrow keys moving backwards and a screen reader hearing the opposite order: the seeded reversed layout.

grader_mapping.title: Chosen pick-up day not preselected as the basket session
grader_mapping.reason: Not one of the thirteen. Genuine: the member picks a date on the tool page, the basket repeats 'Pick up Saturday 17 October', yet demands the same date again from six reverse-ordered radios and errors if it is forgotten; extra work and a slip path on a phone.

grader_mapping.title: No-match search leaves the full list and announces nothing
grader_mapping.reason: Searching 'sewing machine' leaves the status region empty and all ten tools showing with no message; exactly the seeded no-results defect.

grader_mapping.title: 'Reserve this tool' sits outside every landmark
grader_mapping.reason: Minor but genuine accessibility defect with a concrete basis (ARIA snapshot places the button after main, before contentinfo): screen-reader members who move by landmark or read main to its end do not meet the page's primary action. Not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Item headings at the same level as their section heading
grader_mapping.reason: Card and basket item names are h2 under an h2 'Tools' section, so the heading list screen-reader members navigate by is flat and the items read as peers of 'Search' and 'Opening times'. Not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Dark-theme badge green about 3.1:1 on the card surface
grader_mapping.reason: #2f7d4a on #1d2622 for the 16 px bold 'Available from' badge in the dark theme, below 4.5:1; the seeded dark-mode contrast defect (with the token divergence as its cause).

grader_mapping.title: Loan-length listbox captures Tab
grader_mapping.reason: Tab (and Shift+Tab) move to the next option forever with no exit but choosing; the seeded keyboard trap.

grader_mapping.title: Loan-length button's accessible name omits the field label
grader_mapping.reason: A screen-reader member tabbing to the control hears only 'One week, button' with no field name; concrete (aria-labelledby is on the listbox, not the button). Not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Calendar accepts closed days without warning
grader_mapping.reason: All 21 days selectable and a closed Monday 12 October accepted by Reserve; the seeded closed-day defect.

grader_mapping.title: Closed-day refusal only at final confirm with no route back
grader_mapping.reason: The late 'The library is closed on Monday 12 October' refusal with no link back to the day is the second half of the seeded D06 description.

grader_mapping.title: Pick-up before the tool's available-from date is never checked
grader_mapping.reason: Observed end to end (a tool available from Sat 17 reserved and confirmed for Sat 10 with no warning); a member would turn up for a tool that is not back yet. Not among the seeded defects.

grader_mapping.title: Per-tool pick-up day and basket session never reconciled
grader_mapping.reason: The confirm summary can state two collection dates for one reservation ('pick up Saturday 10 October' beside 'Pick-up session: Wednesday 28 October'), so the member does not know when to collect. Not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Continue and Confirm show no visible or disabled busy state
grader_mapping.reason: Same underlying problem as the seeded double submit: Confirm stays enabled with nothing visible during the 1.5 s wait; a visible or disabled pending state is the fix D12 needs.

grader_mapping.title: A second Confirm press allocates a second reservation number
grader_mapping.reason: Second press while pending creates a second reservation and the done page lists 'FT-4471 and FT-4472'; exactly D12.

grader_mapping.title: Done page rebuilds the reservation number from session history with a hard-coded fallback
grader_mapping.reason: Concrete code behaviour: a second reservation for the same session shows both numbers but only the last tools, and an empty store shows a literal 'FT-4471', so a member can be shown numbers that are not for the tools listed or not theirs. A different problem from the double submit, which this fix would not cure.

grader_mapping.title: Ten-minute hold enforced with no warning or extension
grader_mapping.reason: The invisible ten-minute hold behind 'Items are held for you while you finish' is the seeded D10.

grader_mapping.title: Expired hold gives 'Something went wrong. Try again.' and every retry fails
grader_mapping.reason: The misleading generic error after the hold lapses is the second half of the seeded D10 description.

grader_mapping.title: Search form shown above results but after them in tab order above 480 px
grader_mapping.reason: The seeded defect is the stylesheet reordering search relative to the results so keyboard focus runs against the visual order; this is that focus/visual mismatch stated for the wide layout (the detector's jump back to 'Search tools' is the same). Aligning DOM and visual order fixes it.

grader_mapping.title: Results grid minimum column of 330 px overflows at 320 px
grader_mapping.reason: minmax(330px, 1fr) against a 288 px content box, cards 42 px too wide; exactly the seeded D05.

grader_mapping.title: Tool names cut to one line hide the distinguishing words
grader_mapping.reason: nowrap plus ellipsis on card names so the two 18 V drills become indistinguishable on phones; exactly D03.

grader_mapping.title: Fixed action bar not offset; content and focused days under it
grader_mapping.reason: 72 px fixed bar with 8 px page padding and no scroll-padding, footer and focused day buttons covered; exactly D08.

grader_mapping.title: 'Choose a pick-up day first' neither announced nor associated with the calendar
grader_mapping.reason: An error raised by a button press is a plain paragraph with no live region, and focus lands on a day button whose name says nothing about it, so a screen-reader member does not learn why Reserve did nothing. Not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Three-tool limit stated on the find page is not enforced
grader_mapping.reason: Observed: the intro promises up to three tools and a fourth is accepted and confirmed without a word; a member would reserve more than the desk allows and find out at collection. Not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Membership and mobile validation reject common equivalent formats
grader_mapping.reason: Concrete regexes reject 'ft-01234', 'FT 01234' and '+44 7700 900123'; members who type their numbers naturally are blocked at the last step. Not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Card and basket item names are h2 at their section's level
grader_mapping.reason: Same flat heading structure as F-0032 (plus the unstyled 'h3' class on basket rows): screen-reader members navigating by heading lose which items belong to 'Tools'. Not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Done page repeats the first tool name in visually hidden text
grader_mapping.reason: Minor but concrete: screen-reader members hear the tool name twice straight after the tools list and may think two tools are listed. Not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Inline style attributes bypass the spacing tokens
grader_mapping.reason: Code hygiene; the values match the scale and nothing changes for members.

grader_mapping.title: 'Reserve this tool' only adds to a basket with no lasting cue
grader_mapping.reason: A vanishing toast, the same button label and the basket link out of view, so a first-time member thinks they are done; exactly the seeded D07.

grader_mapping.title: Search field after the full tool list on a phone
grader_mapping.reason: Search two screens down after all ten cards at 375 px is the seeded phone reorder.

grader_mapping.title: Results change above the viewport after tapping Search on a phone
grader_mapping.reason: Direct consequence of the seeded reorder that puts search below the ten cards on phones; placing search above the list, the D01 fix, removes it.

grader_mapping.title: Sticky Reserve visible before the required calendar
grader_mapping.reason: On a phone the first viewport offers the primary button while its precondition is below the fold and nothing says a day is needed, so a first press yields an error; concrete and on the main path, though low severity. Not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: 'Choose a pick-up day first.' stays on screen after a day is chosen
grader_mapping.reason: A stale error directly under 'Pick-up day: Friday 16 October' contradicts the page state and is still in the accessibility tree. Not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Basket asks for a session after the day was already chosen
grader_mapping.reason: Same genuine redundancy as F-0029: the member must choose the pick-up date a second time and gets an error if they do not. Not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Session list latest first and includes sessions before the chosen day
grader_mapping.reason: The reverse chronological order of the session radios is the seeded reversed layout; the remark about earlier sessions is secondary.

grader_mapping.title: Header still shows 'Basket (1)' after confirmation
grader_mapping.reason: A stale basket count on the confirmation page suggests something is still pending or the reservation did not go through. Not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Calendar accepts a pick-up day when the library is closed
grader_mapping.reason: Monday 12 October chosen, added and carried into the basket with no warning; exactly D06.

grader_mapping.title: Reservation confirmed for a session before the tool is available
grader_mapping.reason: Same genuine gap as F-0142: the pressure washer listed 'Available from Sat 17 Oct' confirmed for Saturday 10 October; the member would arrive for a tool that is not there. Not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Confirm page shows two different collection dates after changing the session
grader_mapping.reason: Observed contradiction in the summary ('pick up Saturday 17 October' beside 'Wednesday 21 October, 18:00 to 20:00'); the member cannot tell when to collect. Same problem as F-0038, not D13, which is the session being dropped.

grader_mapping.title: Change on the confirm page clears the typed details
grader_mapping.reason: Observed: membership number, name and mobile are empty after Change > session > Continue; re-typing three fields on a phone is a real cost. Not the seeded D13 (the chosen session being dropped with nothing saying so), and keeping the form would not fix that.

grader_mapping.title: Search above the list on desktop but below all ten cards on phones
grader_mapping.reason: The width-dependent reorder that hides search on phones is the seeded D01.

grader_mapping.title: Filter control is an unlabelled icon
grader_mapping.reason: D01 names the icon-only button as the only way to the date and category filters; same problem.

grader_mapping.title: Pick-up sessions listed latest first
grader_mapping.reason: Wednesday 28 at the top, Saturday 10 at the bottom, accessibility tree earliest first; D11.

grader_mapping.title: Loan-length list does not close with Escape
grader_mapping.reason: D09 says 'Escape does nothing' as part of the loan-length trap; this is that half of it.

grader_mapping.title: Two availability badge styles with no explanation
grader_mapping.reason: The badge text already states the date, so the unexplained styling difference neither misleads nor blocks anyone; a presentation preference with no harm shown.

grader_mapping.title: Basket does not say how long tools are held
grader_mapping.reason: 'Items are held for you while you finish' with no time is the seeded invisible hold.

grader_mapping.title: Date filter's helper text contradicts what the filter does
grader_mapping.reason: Concrete: 'tools you could pick up on or after this day' reads as including tools that become available later, yet with 17 October set those are dropped; members who read it would doubt the result. 'The opposite' overstates it, but the ambiguity is real. Not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Session days marked only by a small dot on phones
grader_mapping.reason: On the device most members use, the only cue to which days they can collect is a dot explained in a sentence above, a weak signifier that leads straight into picking a closed day. The seeded D06 is the acceptance of closed days; making sessions recognisable would not by itself fix that, so this stands as its own problem.

grader_mapping.title: Sessions shown latest first, the reverse of the calendar
grader_mapping.reason: Visual order Wednesday 28 to Saturday 10 with accessible order the other way; D11.

grader_mapping.title: Continue and Confirm give no acknowledgement while the next page loads
grader_mapping.reason: No pending state on Confirm (or Continue) during the wait is the seeded condition that produces the double submit; same underlying problem as F-0039.

grader_mapping.title: Open loan-length list hidden behind the fixed bar on phones
grader_mapping.reason: Content covered by the fixed Reserve bar because nothing keeps the page clear of it; the seeded D08.

grader_mapping.title: Remove has no undo or confirmation
grader_mapping.reason: Immediate removal from a one-item basket with cheap recovery is a normal pattern; the finding shows no slip risk, only a preference for undo.

grader_mapping.title: No way to change loan length or pick-up day once in the basket
grader_mapping.reason: Searched every basket and confirm state: the only control is Remove, so changing loan length means removing the tool and redoing the tool page, a common review-time need. Not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Lower-case or unhyphenated membership number reported as missing
grader_mapping.reason: 'Enter your membership number, like FT-01234' tells a member who did enter one that nothing was entered; a misleading recovery message. Not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Fixed bar covers focused controls and the open list on phones
grader_mapping.reason: Focused Loan length button and the 'Two weeks' option behind the fixed bar at 375 px; D08.

grader_mapping.title: Sticky bar sits over calendar rows and overhangs the column
grader_mapping.reason: The bar over the calendar rows and instructions is the seeded uncleared fixed bar; the 80 px overhang at 1280 is cosmetic.

grader_mapping.title: Spec list split into two misaligned label columns
grader_mapping.reason: A 44 px alignment difference between two label groups is visual polish; it does not mislead or impede members.

grader_mapping.title: Same wrench placeholder on every card
grader_mapping.reason: Appeal and specificity; members choose by name and date, and no behaviour or information is affected.

grader_mapping.title: No brand layer on any surface
grader_mapping.reason: A matter of taste and brand; no usability effect on the flow.

grader_mapping.title: Sessions listed latest first (duplicate)
grader_mapping.reason: Restates the reversed session order; D11.

grader_mapping.title: Uneven 1 + 5 session layout at desktop
grader_mapping.reason: Settled. The finding says only 'At 1280 the first session card spans the full width and the other five share a row, with labels wrapping to three lines': a wrapping shape, with no order, keyboard or screen-reader consequence, which is what D11 is. The review reports the order separately (F-0143, its declared duplicate of F-0028/F-0077/F-0092, and F-0125), and those map to D11. Fixing the shape (equal columns, three per row) leaves row-reverse and wrap-reverse in place, and removing the reversal leaves six cards wrapping at five per row as 5 + 1, so neither fix cures the other. A desktop-only shape with legible three-line labels and no stated effect on choosing a session, for members mostly on phones: polish, as both graders treated F-0147, F-0110 and F-0115.

grader_mapping.title: Card titles truncated on phones (duplicate)
grader_mapping.reason: Both drill names render 'Cordless drill 18 V, co...'; D03.

grader_mapping.title: Search below all cards on phones (duplicate)
grader_mapping.reason: Restates the phone reorder; D01.

grader_mapping.title: Nav labels wrap to two lines on phones
grader_mapping.reason: Two-line nav labels remain readable and operable; cosmetic.

grader_mapping.title: Empty bands and half-used columns at wide widths
grader_mapping.reason: Desktop appeal and layout preference; no effect on completing the task.

grader_mapping.title: Masthead still shows 'Basket (1)' after confirmation (duplicate)
grader_mapping.reason: Same genuine stale-count problem as F-0064. Not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Find page overflows horizontally at 320 px
grader_mapping.reason: 346 px capture at 320 px with cards at the right edge; D05.

grader_mapping.title: Search field below all ten tool cards on phones
grader_mapping.reason: Search after the full list at 375 and 320 but under the intro at 768+; D01.

grader_mapping.title: Dark-mode 'Available from' pill loses its tint and goes dim
grader_mapping.reason: #2f7d4a on #1d2622 in the dark theme; D04.

grader_mapping.title: Tool names truncated with an ellipsis on phones
grader_mapping.reason: The two drills become indistinguishable at 375 and 320; D03.

grader_mapping.title: Native date input in locale format beside a native select
grader_mapping.reason: A native date field shows the browser's locale format and gives members their own picker, an accessible choice; the baseline nit is polish. A coherence preference, not a member problem.

grader_mapping.title: Session cards break into 1 + 5 at desktop, earliest last
grader_mapping.reason: The reversed wrapping and the earliest session coming last are the seeded reversed session layout.

grader_mapping.title: Done page has no focal confirmation
grader_mapping.reason: The H1 'Reservation confirmed' and the details table do confirm success; wanting more emphasis is a hierarchy preference. The 'Basket (1)' remark is F-0064's item.

grader_mapping.title: Identity is only the name
grader_mapping.reason: Brand and taste; no usability effect on the flow.

grader_mapping.title: Calendar lacks a month label and the toast lands on its header
grader_mapping.reason: The 21-day grid never leaves October, the readout gives the full date on selection, and the toast covers 'We' for a few seconds; polish rather than something members would act on wrongly.

grader_mapping.title: Find page overflows horizontally at 320 px (detectors)
grader_mapping.reason: Restates the detector overflow and failed reflow at 320 px; D05.

grader_mapping.title: axe colour contrast 3.07:1 (#2f7d4a on #1d2622)

grader_mapping.title: 'Available from Sat 10 Oct' at 3.07:1 in the dark theme
